_about: Plain-words summaries for the web app's Rotation overlay (tools/build-rotations.ts reads them). What each skill does in the rotation, from the tooltip and the sim's kit; the tooltip's own numbers are shown under them.
Scythe Reap: Your combo opener: a three-slash hit that turns on Combo Ready for 4 s. Recast it whenever Combo Ready is about to drop.
Reaping Slash: Spin attack around you that builds Overslash stacks (max 5, last 6 s). Needs Combo Ready to go past 1 stack; with Finisher Ready up it jumps straight to 5 — and it always ends Finisher Ready. Costs 5% of your current HP.
Hellraiser: Fire explosion around you that grants Finisher Ready for 5 s. Cast it with 1 Overslash stack, so the next Reaping Slash takes you to 5.
Sweeping Slash: Two-hit filler (three under Finisher Ready) that also refreshes Combo Ready for 3 s. Weak outside a combo.
Haunting Slice: Dash to the target; at Lv5 it always autocasts Scythe Reap for free — a gap closer that also restarts Combo Ready.
Roaring Overslash: Your finisher: one hit, plus one extra full hit per Overslash stack (6 hits at 5 stacks). Does not use up the stacks. Weaker without Combo Ready. Costs 10% of current SP.
Phantom Slice: Ranged scythe throw that pulls the target in. A cheap 1-second-cooldown filler between combos.
Flaming Wave: Fire line that can set targets Burning. Scales on INT, so weak on a STR/LUK build — only a filler.
Underworld Rainstorm: Rain of hits on an 11x11 area for 3 s, +4% per Overslash stack. Its 5 s cast is cut by Dark Message's Cast Ready or removed by Royal Scythe.
Dark Message: Small push that grants Combo Ready and Cast Ready (variable cast −95%) — used to make Underworld Rainstorm instant.
Dark Messenger: Multi-hit magic based on MATK; weak on a STR build.
Darkside Shadow: Pre-fight buff, 150 s: your shadow gives normal attacks a 100% Double Attack chance, and every physical skill gains +2% damage per DEX.
True Sight: Pre-fight buff, 60 s: +3 to all stats, +30 HIT and +30 crit; also +20% to every weapon attack's ratio (server code).
Vampire Mark: Pre-fight buff, 40 s: physical hits have a 50% chance to heal you for 15% of the damage. Feeds the Ominous Presence shield.
Shadow Parry: Pre-fight buff, 120 s: blocks 30% of physical hits (normal attacks and weapon skills) outright.
Burning Scythe: Fire endow, cast before the pull only when Fire beats your weapon's element on the target (Holy monsters, for a Neutral or Holy scythe).
Ominous Presence: Passive: leech that would overheal you becomes a shield (80% of the overheal), up to Max HP + your STR/LUK/level times Leech Power. This is what keeps a low-HP Revenant alive.
Shadow Slash: Dash-in opener: three crit attempts on the target. Puts you in melee instantly.
New Moon: Starts the Moon combo: hits around you and turns you invisible (halves damage taken) until you attack. Scales with AGI and Elemental Focus.
Full Moon: Only from New Moon: the big hit of the combo (AGI and Focus scaling), and it grants Combo Ready.
Million Stab: Rapid stabs; only cast under Combo Ready, where DEX adds to it.
Thousand Arms: 7x7 spin filler between Moon combos; costs 5% current HP.
Dragon Omamori: Puts a talisman on the target (cast under Combo Ready); Omamori Jutsu detonates it.
Omamori Jutsu: Detonates your Dragon Omamori talisman for big damage, and makes you invisible — which lets Full Moon follow.
Kawarimi: Dodge: the next physical hit misses and you step back a cell.
Moonlight Stance: Pre-fight stance: required for every Moon skill, and +2% Max HP per level.
Seven Winds: Pre-fight endow: picks the element that hits the target hardest for 5 minutes.
Bishop's Tax: Hit that makes the target take 15% more damage for up to 12 s; cast right before Shield Boomerang into King's Chains. Costs 25% Max HP.
Shield Boomerang: Shield throw that opens the King's Chains combo (x1.5 with the Bulwark Gem).
King's Chains: The main hit: four shield throws, scaling with VIT, STR and your Duel Counters; spends one counter.
Rook's Smash: Slide onto the target for 2-3 hits plus a fifth of your current HP as damage; fills Duel Counters to 3.
Duel Stance: Pre-fight stance: physical hits you take build Duel Counters; +Max HP.
King's Fortress: Pre-fight shield aura; at Lv3 it adds STR and VIT scaling to King's Chains and Shield Boomerang.
Knight's Regen: Pre-fight regen: heals a share of Max HP every 5 s for minutes.
Bishop's Guard: Pre-fight buff: +500 Max HP per level and more VIT defence.
Reflect Shield: Pre-fight buff: sends a share of melee damage you take back at the attacker.
